mentions.name: Custom ESP32 OS
mentions.description: A custom operating system for an ESP32 device that includes power management, a launcher, an iOS-inspired Control Center, an AI voice assistant built on the OpenAI Realtime API, a tamagotchi-style app, and an iBeer app.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have tons of fun building a custom OS for my little ESP32 device: https://x.com/daniel_nguyenx/status/2086311226012025006

It now has power management, a launcher, iOS-inspired Control Center, an AI voice assistant (using OpenAI Realtime API), a tamagotchi-style app and I recently built the iBeer app :D
mentions.author: longnguyen
